Renderings: the Sumerian Flood Story (project glossary)

Contents
  • 1. Names
  • 2. Recurring words
  • 3. Formulas

Words, names and formulas used in this text and not (or not yet) in the shared ../renderings.md. The shared file binds; this one extends it. Lemmas are ePSD2 citation forms cf[gw] (ORACC Q000357). Echo tags per guidelines §6.4.

1. Names

Sumerian Hebrew (first occurrence vocalized) Lines Notes
Ziusudra zi-ud-su₃-ra₂ זִיוּסוּדְרָה C 11, 18; D 7, 9; E 4, 6, 9 Shared. Name = "life of distant days"; Akk. Ūta-napišti "he found life" may be a reinterpretation. Poebel 1914 read "Ziugiddu".
An אַן A 11, C 9–10, C 25, E 2, 5, 6 Shared. Distinguish from an "heaven" (שָׁמַיִם).
Enlil אֶנְלִיל A 11, C 9–10, C 25, E 2, 5, 6; Ur r 6′, 9′ Shared.
Enki אֶנְקִי A 11, C 8–9 Shared.
Nudimmud נוּדִימּוּד B 11 Epithet-name of Enki ("the one who fashions/begets").
Ninḫursaĝa נִין־חֻרְסַגָּה A 11, C 9 Shared.
Nintur נִינְתּוּר A 3, C 6 Sumerian form of Nintu (shared נִינְתּוּ).
Inana אִינַנָּה C 7 Not Ištar/אִשְׁתַּר in a Sumerian text.
Utu אוּתוּ B 14, D 6, 8, 10; E 11 Shared. The sun-god; {d}utu e₃ = sunrise.
Pabilsaĝ פַּבִּילְסַג B 13 The scribe wrote pa-bil₂-«ḫur»-saĝ.
Sud סוּד B 15 Goddess of Šuruppag (later identified with Ninlil). First occurrence: (הָאֵלָה) סוּד to prevent reading "secret".
nu-gig הַגְּבִירָה B 12 "High-status woman", epithet of Inana.
Šakkan שַׁכַּן Ur o 8′ God of wild animals / the steppe.
Ki-ur קִי־אוּר C 17 Enlil's temple court in Nippur.
Eridug, Bad-tibira, Larag, Zimbir, Šuruppag אֶרִידוּ, בַּד־טִיבִּירָה, לָרַךְ, סִיפַּר, שׁוּרוּפַּךְ B 11–15; Ur r 7′ Shared (Akkadian forms). The Sumerian form is given in the note at first occurrence.
Dilmun דִּלְמוּן E 11 Shared. Bahrain and the Gulf coast; a land "beyond the sea".

2. Recurring words

Sumerian (ePSD2) Hebrew Rejected Reason Lines Tag
amaru[flood] מַבּוּל — Shared. C 3, 22; D 2, 4 [equivalent]
ma[ship] ({ĝiš}ma₂) סְפִינָה תֵּבָה Shared. ma₂ gur₄-gur₄ "the thick/massive boat" → הַסְּפִינָה הָעֲנָקִית. D 5, 7, 8 [divergence]
ur[drag] (ur₃) שָׁטַף סָחַף, הֵצִיף "Drag, sweep, raze". Shared §3a: שָׁטַף (not סחף); no Genesis word. C 22; D 2, 4 —
namlulu[humanity] הָאֱנוֹשׁוּת הָאָדָם = awīlūtu. A 2; C 4, 23; E 10; Ur —
uŋ[people] הָאֲנָשִׁים הָעָם = nišū. A 4; C 7 —
saŋ giggig שְׁחוֹרֵי הָרֹאשׁ — Standard epithet of mankind. A 12 —
niŋgilim[rodent] הַיְּצוּרִים הַקְּטַנִּים שֶׁרֶץ, רֶמֶשׂ, חַיּוֹת Small creatures; the Genesis words would pre-empt. A 13; E 3, 10 [equivalent] with שֶׁרֶץ/רֶמֶשׂ
mašanše[animals] הַמִּקְנֶה בְּהֵמָה Lit. "goats-and-donkeys" = livestock, animals. A 14 [equivalent]
niŋurlimmu[creature] הַהוֹלְכִים עַל אַרְבַּע — "Four-legged"; cf. Lev 11:20 wording, not Genesis. A 14 —
eden[steppe] עֲרָבָה עֵדֶן Echo control (etymology note). A 14; Ur o 2′ (an-eden: הָעֲרָבָה הָעֶלְיוֹנָה) [cognate?]
dim[create] עִצֵּב יָצַר, עָשָׂה, בָּרָא "Fashion, shape"; the neutral Hebrew verb. A 12; C 12 [equivalent] with יָצַר
niŋdimdima[creature] יְצוּרִים (יְצוּרַי) בְּרוּאִים Ordinary noun; root יצר noted. A 3 —
halam[forsake] אָבַד (פִּעֵל: אִבֵּד); noun אָבְדָן הִשְׁמִיד, כִּלָּה "Destroy, make disappear" (Akk. ḫalāqu D); the same root in A 2 and C 23. A 2; C 23 —
numun[seed] זֶרַע — Meaning first; = Akk. zēru. C 23; E 10 [equivalent]
zi[life] חַיִּים נֶפֶשׁ In oath (zi an-na) and in zi da-ri₂. E 1, 2, 8 —
til[live] (til₃) חַיִּים (noun, E 7); יָשַׁב/הוֹשִׁיב (E 11 causative, E 12) — til₃ = "live, dwell". E 7, 11, 12 —
dari[eternal] נֶצַח (zi da-ri₂ = חַיֵּי נֶצַח) עוֹלָם Avoid pre-empting Gen 3:22. E 8 [equivalent]
diŋir[deity] + -gin₇ כָּאֵל כֵּאלֹהִים Shared ilu = אֵל. E 7, 8 —
kab dug₄-ga הַחֲלָקוֹת הַמְּדוּדוֹת? — See project.md Decisions §2. Identical in all four lines. B 10, 16; C 22; D 2 —
ŋarza[rites] הַטְּקָסִים — A 9; B 8 —
me[Being] + mah הַ־מֶה הַנִּשְׂגָּבִים חֻקִּים The divine powers/ordinances; kept transliterated (2026-10-21). A 9; B 8 —
mah[great] נִשְׂגָּב נַעֲלֶה, גָּדוֹל Used for men mah too. A 9; B 7, 8 —
kug[pure] טָהוֹר קָדוֹשׁ ki kug-ga = בִּמְקוֹמוֹת טְהוֹרִים; kug {d}inana = אִינַנָּה הַטְּהוֹרָה. A 6, 7; B 9; C 7 —
šeg[brick] + šub לְבֵנִים + הִנִּיחַ — "Lay the bricks". A 6; B 9 [equivalent] with 11:3
ki[place] מָקוֹם; אֶרֶץ (in an ki); אֲדָמָה (irrigated ground, A 10) — The annotated file names the Sumerian behind each. passim —
kalam[land] הָאָרֶץ — "The Land" (Sumer) = mātu. B 5; D 4 —
an[sky] שָׁמַיִם — an ki = שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ. B 6, 7; C 1, 10, 16; D 6; E 1, 2 [equivalent] with 1:1 pair
namlugal[kingship] מַלְכוּת מְלוּכָה B 6, 7; C 26 —
lugal[king] מֶלֶךְ — Z. lugal-am₃ = זִיוּסוּדְרָה, הַמֶּלֶךְ in every occurrence. C 11; D 9, 11; E 4, 9 —
šul[youth] הָעֶלֶם גִּבּוֹר Utu's epithet. B 14; D 8 —
izzida[side-wall] קִיר הַצַּד גָּדֵר Addressed in the warning. C 19, 20 [divergence] with 6:13
egar[wall] (e₂-ĝar₈) קִיר — = Akk. igāru (loan from Sumerian). C 17 —
inim[word] דָּבָר — = amātu (shared). C 13, 15, 20, 24, 25 —
na de₅ (noun) עֵצָה הוֹרָאָה, מוּסָר "Instruction, advice" (cf. the title of the Instructions of Šuruppag). C 21 —
ŋizzal[ear] ak הִקְשִׁיב — "Pay attention". C 21 —
ŋeš tuku שָׁמַע — "Hear, listen". C 18 —
mu pad₃ נִשְׁבַּע בְּשֵׁם — "Invoke the name", i.e. swear. zi an-na … pad₃ = נִשְׁבַּע בְּחַיֵּי. C 10, 16; E 1, 2 —
ditila[case] דִּין חָלוּט — "Completed (closed) lawsuit". C 24 —
puhrum[assembly] אֲסֵפָה עֵדָה Shared puḫru. A loanword from Akkadian in the Sumerian text. C 24 —
nam[fate] + tar גּוֹרָל + נִגְזַר — C 23 —
imhul[wind] רוּחַ רָעָה, pl. רוּחוֹת רָעוֹת סְעָרָה Akk. imḫullu "evil wind". D 1, 5 —
sisig[breeze] סְעָרָה — "Wind, gale". D 1 —
abbur (ab-BUR₂) + burud חֲרַךְ + קָדַח חַלּוֹן, צֹהַר An opening bored through; Song 2:9 הַחֲרַכִּים. D 7 [equivalent] with צֹהַר/חַלּוֹן
ŋešnu[light] אוֹר קֶרֶן D 8 —
kiri ki sub + gub הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה, אַפּוֹ אַרְצָה — "Rub the nose on the ground". D 10; E 5 —
gaz[kill] שָׁחַט זָבַח The verb is "kill"; the sacrificial context is clear. D 11 —
šar[numerous] הִרְבָּה — "Make numerous" (offer many). D 11 —
kurbal[country] אֶרֶץ הַמַּעֲבָר — "Land across (the sea)". E 11 —
ud-ba, ud-bi-a בָּעֵת הַהִיא בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם C 6, 11; E 9; Ur o 3′, 11′ [equivalent] with 6:4
nesaŋ[offering] רֵאשִׁית — "First-fruit offering" → "the first". רֵאשִׁית carries both senses. B 11 [equivalent] with 10:10
n-kam-ma(-še₃) הַשְּׁנִיָּה, הַשְּׁלִישִׁית … — Ordinals, feminine (עִיר). B 12–15; Ur r 2′–4′ —

3. Formulas

Sumerian Hebrew Lines
ŋarza me mah šu mi-ni-ib-šu-du₇ אֶת הַטְּקָסִים וְאֶת הַ־מֶה הַנִּשְׂגָּבִים הִשְׁלִים A 9 = B 8
an {d}en-lil₂ {d}en-ki {d}nin-hur-saŋ-ŋa₂-ke₄ אַן, אֶנְלִיל, אֶנְקִי וְנִין־חֻרְסַגָּה A 11 = C 9
zi-ud-su₃-ra₂ lugal-am₃ זִיוּסוּדְרָה, הַמֶּלֶךְ D 9 = E 4; with ud-ba: C 11, E 9
igi X-še₃ giri₁₇ ki su-ub ba-gub לִפְנֵי X — הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה, אַפּוֹ אַרְצָה D 10, E 5
mu-bi ba-an-sa₄ kab dug₄-ga ba-hal-hal-la (אֶת) שְׁמָן קָרָא, וְהַחֲלָקוֹת הַמְּדוּדוֹת? חֻלְּקוּ B 10, B 16
a-ma-ru ugu kab dug₄-ga … ur₃ הַמַּבּוּל … עַל הַחֲלָקוֹת הַמְּדוּדוֹת? … שָׁטַף C 22, D 2
zi an-na zi ki-a i₃-pad₃-de₃-(en-)ze₂-en בְּחַיֵּי הַשָּׁמַיִם, בְּחַיֵּי הָאָרֶץ — תִּשָּׁבְעוּ E 1, E 2
X-kam-ma(-še₃) <city> <god>-ra mi-ni-in-šum₂ הַ<ordinal>, <city>, נָתַן לְ<god> B 11–15

2026-10-21 harmonization (the lead's cross-corpus decisions): me = הַ־מֶה (always vocalized), me maḫ = הַ־מֶה הַנִּשְׂגָּבִים, replacing הַכֹּחוֹת הַנִּשְׂגָּבִים in A 9 = B 8 (rows above fixed). Inana = אִינַנָּה always vocalized (already so). nam-šub = קֶסֶם: the apparatus now calls Enmerkar 136–140 "קסם נודימוד" (was "לחש").
